title: Command
description: LDS-L1 canonical command envelope (doc 44 G2.5). Sent on syn/{site}/{area}/{line}/{cell}/{equip}/cmd — ALWAYS via the policy/actuation gate, never raw. additionalProperties stays open.

command_id.description: Globally-unique command id (uuid) — ack correlates on this

correlation_id.description: Business correlation (work order / workflow run id)

verb.description: Capability verb (e.g. start, stop, reset, setParam)

args.description: Verb arguments (validated against the capability signature downstream)

issued_by.description: Principal that issued the command (user id / service account)

policy_ref.description: Reference to the policy decision that authorised this command

deadline_ms.description: Validity window — the device must reject execution after deadline

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key — re-delivery with the same key must not re-execute
